column1: %1$s becomes the date and time of the save, %2$s the video's number on Facebook, %3$s who posted it, %4$s their profile's number on Facebook and %5$s the day it was posted. What a save doesn't know is left out, and a name with none of these gets the date added. When the name is already in the folder, the time of the save goes on the end. Invalid characters become underscores. Leave it blank to use the default, %6$s.
column2: %1$s diganti dengan tanggal dan waktu penyimpanan, %2$s dengan nomor video di Facebook, %3$s dengan nama pengunggahnya, %4$s dengan nomor profilnya di Facebook, dan %5$s dengan tanggal unggahnya. Yang tidak diketahui saat menyimpan akan dihilangkan, dan nama tanpa satu pun di antaranya akan ditambahi tanggal. Jika nama itu sudah ada di folder, waktu penyimpanan ditambahkan di akhir. Karakter yang tidak valid menjadi garis bawah. Kosongkan untuk memakai nama bawaan, %6$s.

Opt-out read: %1$s. Triggered read: %2$s.
column2: Pembacaan penolakan: %1$s. Pembacaan pemicu: %2$s.

column1: # context: a read's result in that toast
no answer
column2: tidak ada jawaban

column1: # context: a read's result in that toast
answered
column2: dijawab

column1: # context: a read's result in that toast; the placeholder is an error's class name, left in English
failed (%1$s)
column2: gagal (%1$s)

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the dot is the tab bar's new-item badge
Hide the Reels tab dot
column2: Sembunyikan titik di tab Reels

column1: # context: summary of that switch; Video is Facebook's name for the tab on some accounts
No dot or new count on the Reels tab, called Video on some accounts. Other tabs keep theirs.
column2: Tanpa titik atau jumlah baru di tab Reels, yang di beberapa akun bernama Video. Tab lain tetap menampilkannya.

column1: # context: title of the overview row under the status card when the build lacks one patch Morphe Manager selects by default
%1$d default patch isn't in this build
column2: %1$d tambalan default tidak ada di build ini

column1: # context: title of that row when several default patches are missing
%1$d default patches aren't in this build
column2: %1$d tambalan default tidak ada di build ini

column1: # context: summary of that row while its list of patch names is closed; a tap opens it
Tap to see which.
column2: Ketuk untuk melihat yang mana.

column1: # context: that row's summary once opened, one patch missing; the placeholder is the patch's English name as Morphe Manager lists it
Not in this build: %1$s. Morphe Manager selects it by default. Patch again with it selected to get what it does.
column2: Tidak ada di build ini: %1$s. Morphe Manager memilihnya secara default. Pilih tambalan itu lalu tambal ulang untuk mendapatkan fungsinya.

column1: # context: that row's summary once opened, several patches missing; the placeholder is their English names joined as a list
Not in this build: %1$s. Morphe Manager selects them by default. Patch again with them selected to get what they do.
column2: Tidak ada di build ini: %1$s. Morphe Manager memilihnya secara default. Pilih tambalan itu lalu tambal ulang untuk mendapatkan fungsinya.

column1: # context: Toast at the end of a video save whose file uses a codec WhatsApp and some video editors can't open (AV1, VP9, HEVC or xHE-AAC). A notification with a button to the fix is showing too. Keep it short: Android shows two lines at most.
Saved, but WhatsApp and some editors may refuse it
column2: Disimpan, tetapi WhatsApp dan beberapa editor mungkin menolaknya

column1: # context: Toast at the end of a video save whose file WhatsApp may not open, when no notification can be shown. Downloads is the section of Hushfacebook settings with the fix. Two lines at most.
Saved, but WhatsApp may refuse it. Fix: Downloads in Hushfacebook.
column2: Disimpan, tetapi WhatsApp mungkin menolaknya. Solusi: Unduhan di Hushfacebook.

column1: # context: Second line of the notification after such a save. %1$s is the switch's name, Save videos other apps can open. They: WhatsApp and the editors.
Turn on %1$s to save videos they all play.
column2: Aktifkan %1$s untuk menyimpan video yang bisa diputar semuanya.

column1: # context: Title of the notification after a video save whose file uses a codec WhatsApp and some video editors can't open.
WhatsApp and some editors may refuse this video
column2: WhatsApp dan beberapa editor mungkin menolak video ini

column1: # context: Button on that notification. It opens Hushfacebook settings at the switch Save videos other apps can open.
Open the setting
column2: Buka pengaturan

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the prompts are the strip Facebook puts under some posts, such as "Are you interested in this post?"
Hide post prompts
column2: Sembunyikan pertanyaan di bawah postingan

column1: # context: description of that switch; the quoted texts are Facebook's own prompts, so use Facebook's wording in your language if you know it
The strip on some posts, like "Are you interested in this post?", "Show less" or who recently commented, and the follow and chat suggestions in the same place. The post stays.
column2: Strip pada beberapa postingan, seperti “Apakah Anda tertarik dengan postingan ini?”, “Tampilkan lebih sedikit” atau siapa yang baru saja berkomentar, serta saran untuk mengikuti dan mengobrol di tempat yang sama. Postingannya tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Meta AI is the name of Meta's assistant, and the questions are the row of suggested questions for it that Facebook puts under some posts
Hide Meta AI questions under posts
column2: Sembunyikan pertanyaan Meta AI di bawah postingan

column1: # context: description of that switch; a link card is the preview of a shared link inside a post
The row of Meta AI questions under some posts. The post, its link card and its buttons stay.
column2: Baris pertanyaan Meta AI di bawah beberapa postingan. Postingan, kartu tautannya, dan tombolnya tetap ada.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; it keeps the date shown under the name of whoever posted
Keep post dates
column2: Pertahankan tanggal postingan

column1: # context: description of that switch; the rotating details are the texts Facebook's newer post header takes turns showing on that line
The line under the poster's name keeps the post's date instead of Facebook's rotating details, which go blank on some phones.
column2: Baris di bawah nama orang yang memposting tetap menampilkan tanggal postingan, bukan detail yang bergantian dari Facebook, yang di beberapa ponsel menjadi kosong.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the Feeds header is the row at the top of the Feeds tab with Feeds, the menu and search, and the filters under it, All, Favorites, Friends, Groups and Pages
Hide the Feeds header
column2: Sembunyikan bagian atas Feed

column1: # context: description of that switch; the Feeds tab is where Facebook lists posts by those filters, and the title row is the one with the tab's name
Open the Feeds tab on its posts, without the title row or the filters under it. Restart Facebook after changing it.
column2: Membuka tab Feed langsung di postingannya, tanpa baris judul dan filter di bawahnya. Mulai ulang Facebook setelah mengubahnya.

column1: # context: switch title under Reels and Watch; the prompt is Facebook's "Are you interested in this reel?" question on a reel
Hide reel interest prompts
column2: Sembunyikan pertanyaan minat di reel

column1: # context: description of that switch; the quoted text is Facebook's own prompt, so use Facebook's wording in your language if you know it
No "Are you interested in this reel?" prompt on reels. The reel plays as usual.
column2: Tanpa pertanyaan “Apakah Anda tertarik dengan reel ini?” di reel. Reel diputar seperti biasa.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; affiliate product links are the shop links creators add to their posts to earn a commission
Hide affiliate product links
column2: Sembunyikan tautan produk afiliasi

column1: # context: description of that switch; "Commission eligible" is Facebook's own label, so use Facebook's wording in your language if you know it
The product cards of shop links creators add to posts, on reels, under feed posts and in the comments. The "Commission eligible" label stays.
column2: Kartu produk dari tautan toko yang ditambahkan kreator ke postingan, di reel, di bawah postingan feed, dan di komentar. Label “Memenuhi syarat komisi” tetap ada.

column1: # context: The reel button and the video menu item while links are sent to another app (#41)
Send to app
column2: Kirim ke aplikasi

column1: # context: Title of Android's app chooser when a video's link is sent
Send the link to
column2: Kirim tautan ke

column1: # context: Toast when no app could take a video's link
Couldn't open an app for this link
column2: Tidak bisa membuka aplikasi untuk tautan ini

column1: # context: Clipboard label of a copied video link
Video link
column2: Tautan video

column1: # context: Toast after a long press on the reel button copied its link
Link copied
column2: Tautan disalin

column1: # context: Toast when a reel's link can't be built
Couldn't find this reel's link
column2: Tautan reel ini tidak ditemukan

column1: # context: Toast when a feed video's link can't be built
Couldn't find this video's link
column2: Tautan video ini tidak ditemukan

column1: # context: Settings row title: what the Download button does
When you tap Download
column2: Saat mengetuk Unduh

column1: # context: Choice of the download action row
Save to phone
column2: Simpan ke ponsel

column1: # context: Choice of the download action row
Send the link to an app
column2: Kirim tautan ke aplikasi

column1: # context: Summary of the download action row while links are sent
Reels and videos go to the app below as a facebook.com link. Hold the reel Download button to copy the link instead. Stories still save to this phone.
column2: Reel dan video dikirim ke aplikasi di bawah sebagai tautan facebook.com. Tahan tombol Unduh pada reel untuk menyalin tautannya. Cerita tetap disimpan di ponsel ini.

column1: # context: Summary of the download action row while saving, the default
Reels, videos and stories save to this phone.
column2: Reel, video, dan cerita disimpan di ponsel ini.

column1: # context: Settings row title: the app links are sent to
App to send to
column2: Aplikasi tujuan

column1: # context: Dialog message of the send-to app row; %1$s and %2$s are package names
The package name of the app that gets the links, such as %1$s for YTDLnis or %2$s for Seal. Leave it blank to pick an app each time.
column2: Nama paket aplikasi yang menerima tautan, misalnya %1$s untuk YTDLnis atau %2$s untuk Seal. Biarkan kosong untuk memilih aplikasi setiap kali.

column1: # context: Hint in the send-to app field
Package name
column2: Nama paket

column1: # context: Toast when what was typed in the send-to app row isn't a package name; %1$s is what was typed
%1$s isn't a package name, so the app stays as it was.
column2: %1$s bukan nama paket, jadi aplikasinya tetap.

column1: # context: Summary of the send-to app row with no app named
Android asks which app each time.
column2: Android menanyakan aplikasi setiap kali.

column1: # context: Summary of the send-to app row; %1$s is the package name
Links go to %1$s. When it isn't installed, Android asks which app.
column2: Tautan dikirim ke %1$s. Jika tidak terpasang, Android menanyakan aplikasinya.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; Find friends from contacts is the Stories tray card that asks to upload your contacts
Hide "Find friends from contacts"
column2: Sembunyikan “Temukan teman dari kontak”

column1: # context: summary of that switch
The Stories tray card asking to upload your contacts. Applies when Facebook next loads the tray.
column2: Kartu di baki cerita yang meminta Anda mengunggah kontak. Berlaku saat Facebook memuat ulang baki.

column1: # context: summary of Hide "People you may know" when the build also hides tray cards; Add is the card's button
The row of friend suggestions between posts, the one on your own profile, and the cards with an Add button in the Stories tray.
column2: Deretan saran pertemanan di antara postingan, deretan di profilmu sendiri, dan kartu dengan tombol Tambah di baki cerita.
